decisionsTitle: «Echipa» as an organisational chart: who answers to whom, the responsibilities, and the page's boxes
decisionsSection:
**The club's president, through the owner, 2026-10-10:** «Echipa» should read like an organisational chart — «structura organizațională și responsabilități». Her drawing: the president/founder's card on top (photo, name, the role title «Președinte/Fondator», four lines of responsibilities), an advisor's card beside it («Advisor Relații Publice», one line), a row of five role cards under them — each with photo, name, a role title, one line of sub-role and a «Responsabilități:» bullet list of four to six items — and three boxes at the bottom: a shared responsibility with bullets, the partnerships the founder keeps with four partner logos, and a governance note of three paragraphs. **The owner:** «of course, all of these cards and relationships must be configurable». Nothing of the drawing's names or words is in the repository, which is public: fixtures say «Președinte», «Rol A», «Partener 1»; the words are the club's to type on the site.

**Decision (amends §459).**

- **Four more pairs on a card, both languages or neither (§352).** `team_members.subtitle_ro` / `subtitle_en` — the one-line sub-role under the role title, at most 120 characters, collapsed to one line — and `responsibilities_ro` / `responsibilities_en` — one responsibility per line, at most twelve lines of 160 characters, blank lines dropped, kept joined by one line break and drawn as a bullet list under «Responsabilități» / "Responsibilities". A one-sided pair is refused on the empty box (§315); the role title stays `role_*`, drawn in the accent colour.
- **Whom a card answers to is a reference, not a word.** `team_members.reports_to_id` is a nullable foreign key to `team_members(id)` with `ON DELETE SET NULL`, so a renamed card keeps its place in the chart and a deleted card leaves its children at the top with nothing else to do; `CHECK team_members_reports_to_not_self` refuses the trivial circle at the database, and the save refuses every other one — self, a card that does not exist, and a circle of any length — by walking the parent chain inside the save's own transaction (a visited set ends a stale cycle in the data), naming the «Răspunde în fața» box and keeping everything typed. `team_members.placement` (`below` | `beside`, `CHECK team_members_placement_known`, default `below`) says whether the card hangs in the tier under its parent or sits at the parent's tier to its right, the president's advisor; the service writes `below` for a root, whatever was posted.
- **The layout is pure.** `content/team/domain/org-chart.ts#buildOrgChart` takes the shown cards in the club's order and gives the tree and its tiers: roots are the cards with no parent *or whose parent is not among the shown cards* — a shown card is never dropped; children keep `position` order; a `beside` card is attached to its parent's node, drawn after it at the parent's tier, with its own cards under it; a card's own children come before its neighbour's in the tier under; a stale cycle terminates and its cards become roots in the list's order. `hasRelations` is false while no shown card names a shown parent.
- **The grid is kept until the club sets a relation.** The public page draws exactly the grid it always drew while `hasRelations` is false, so the club's current page changes nothing on this release. Once a relation is set it draws the chart: the roots' tier, under each group the cards that answer to it, each a wrapping row of fixed-width cards from `sm` and one column on a phone with the children indented behind a left rule; the connectors are CSS borders and pseudo-elements on Server Components — no script, no client island, the theme's `divider` and never a hex. A card is the same component in both layouts: the photo in its crop (§541), the name, the role title, the subtitle, the responsibilities, then the bio and the links as before (§474), every link 44 px. Hidden cards are never in the HTML. The menu, the sitemap, `noindex` and the privacy-notice marker of §459 are unchanged: the chart publishes nothing new about a person beyond the club's words about their role.
- **The page's boxes.** A new table, `team_page_boxes` (migration `0134`, expand only): `title_ro` / `title_en` (both always, at most 120 characters), `body_ro_json` / `body_en_json` (the rich text with a bio's allowlist — paragraphs, lists, links, pictures, no table — both languages or neither), `body_ro` / `body_en` (the plain words, written by every save as a bio's are, §474), `position`, `visible` (a new box starts hidden), the two staff references, `version`, the timestamps, and an index on (`visible`, `position`). The partners' logos are pictures in the text: a picture in a rich text is one. The public page draws the shown boxes under the chart — and under the grid — in order, a heading and the text through the renderer every page uses; a box whose text is written in one language only, or in neither, is left out on both pages.
- **The two gates of §459, reused.** Writing a box (adding, saving, moving, deleting a hidden one) is `canEditTeamPage`, the Redactor's and the Administrator's; «Pe site», taking off and deleting a shown one is `canShowTeamMember`, the Administrator's. No new role rule. Every write audits the box by id and the actor under the entity type `team_page_box` — `team.box.created|saved|moved|shown|hidden|deleted` — never its words (§12.12), against the loaded `version` (AGENTS.md §11.5), and expires the `pages` cache (§333). A card's existing save action covers the new columns.
- **The editor.** Each card's form gains «Subtitlu» (RO/EN), «Responsabilități» (RO/EN textareas, «una pe rând»), «Răspunde în fața» (a native select of the other cards by name, «— nimeni, în vârf —» first) and «Așezare» («sub» / «alături de»). A new fold under the cards' list, «Casetele paginii», in the shape of the discount codes' card (§552): the count on its line, a form to add one, each box a row with its title, state and arrows, its own «Pe site», delete and an edit fold with the title pair and the rich-text editor per language (the bio's editor, folded until opened, §96); every outward verb asks first (§384) and toasts; a refusal names its box and keeps what was typed (§315). The Redactor's guide gains one task saying how.
- **Pictures.** `media/references.ts` counts a picture inside `team_page_boxes.body_*_json` as referenced, by address like every other text, hidden boxes included, so the orphan sweep never takes a partner's logo and a delete from the pictures page is refused while a box uses it. The pictures page lists it under a new reference kind, `teamBox` — the box's id and its title in the reader's language, linking to that box on «Echipa»'s screen — and the picker files it under «Echipa» with the page's introduction. A new kind rather than `teamIntro`, because that kind's row says «introducerea» and would have named the wrong place.

**Refused.**

- *A fixed chart typed in code.* The club changes; the owner asked for every card and relation to be configurable.
- *A second table for the relations.* One column on the card says whom it answers to; a table of edges would let a card have two parents, which a chart cannot draw.
- *A client-side chart library, or any script.* CSS borders and pseudo-elements draw the stems and the rules on Server Components; the page stays static and script-free, as §549 made it.
- *A special box kind for the partner logos.* A picture in a rich text already has an upload, a crop, a gallery pick and a reference; a logo band would be a second way to do one thing.
- *A free-text «reports to» name.* A reference keeps the chart true when a card is renamed or removed; a typed name would silently detach.
- *Drawing the chart as soon as the columns exist.* While nobody names a parent the page is the grid it was, so this release changes nothing the club's visitors see.

**Tests.** Unit, `content/team-org-chart.test.ts`: `buildOrgChart` (one tier without relations, children in order tier by tier, a beside card at its parent's tier with its own children, a hidden parent making a root and counting as no relation, a stale cycle terminating with every card once, a self-parent ignored); the fields (both or neither for the subtitle and the responsibilities, one line per responsibility, twelve lines and 160 characters, the parent as a uuid, self detected, `below` for a root, an unknown placement refused; a box's title in both languages, its text both or neither, no table). Unit, `content/team-page-render.test.ts`: the grid while no shown card has a shown parent, the chart with its labelled tiers and the subtitle and bullets, the boxes under either layout, no script. Integration on PGlite, `cms/team-org-chart.test.ts`: the pairs stored and read per language, self and a circle of two and three refused on the box with nothing written, the database's own two checks, a deleted parent's child left at the top, the Redactor's and the Administrator's gates on a box, the version guard, the public read of shown boxes only, one audit row per write naming the id and never the words, and a picture inside a box kept by the sweep, named on the pictures page in each language, refused for deletion, then swept once the box is gone.
changelogLine: - **«Echipa» as an organisational chart** — a card may say whom it answers to and whether it sits below or beside that person, carry a sub-role line and a «Responsabilități» list, and the page may carry titled rich-text boxes under the chart (the partners' logos as pictures); the page stays the grid until a relation is set, the chart is CSS alone, hidden cards and boxes are never in the HTML, and a box follows the cards' two gates. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given the team page, when a card names the card it answers to and whether it sits below or beside it, then the page draws the shown cards as tiers with connectors — roots first, each parent's children under it in position order, a beside card at its parent's tier, a child whose parent is hidden a root of its own — and as the grid it always drew while no shown card names a shown parent; a card answering to itself, to a missing card or to its own descendant is refused on «Răspunde în fața» with the rest kept, and a deleted parent's children stay with no parent; the sub-role and the responsibilities are both languages or neither, at most 120 characters and twelve lines of 160; hidden cards are never in the HTML (2026-10-10, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given the team page's boxes (`team_page_boxes`), when a Redactor or an Administrator adds, writes, moves or deletes a hidden one, then it is kept with its title in both languages and its rich text in both or neither, hidden until an Administrator shows it; showing, hiding and deleting a shown box is the Administrator's alone; the public page draws the shown boxes in order under the chart or the grid and never a hidden one or a half-written one; every write leaves an audit row naming the box by id and never its words; a picture inside a box's text counts as a media reference for the sweep, the delete guard and the pictures page (2026-10-10, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: «Echipa» as an organisational chart with its boxes
